tasks.title: Meta path map + frameStore storage seam
tasks.whatChanged: Added FRAME_META_FILES (the .frame/-relative meta path map) and LEGACY_ROOT_FILES to src/shared/frameConstants.js, and built src/main/frameStore.js — a data-shaped API (readTasks/writeTasks, structure, notes, quickstart, config, the project AGENTS layer) with separately named …Path(projectPath) entries for the watchers, .frame/bin/ scripts and AI-tool-facing files that need a real path. Covered by 12 cases in test/frameStore.test.js.
tasks.whyChanged: The API returns data rather than paths so the later move to a Frame-owned store is a backend swap behind these functions instead of a second pass over every caller. JSON reads pass fsSafe's { data, source, error } envelope through untouched — collapsing it to data||null would re-introduce the silent-null failure tasksManager grew out of. Diverged from plan.md on ORCH_META_FILES: left as bare file names, because both consumers match a footprint entry's basename, which is already layout-agnostic; .frame/-relative paths there would have silently killed every match.
